newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty fixed weaker at 2.35 pct from parity rate.
newsitem.headline: Zloty fixed weaker at 2.35 pct from parity rate.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland fixed the zloty at 3.1685 to the dollar, down from 3.1630 on Monday and at 1.8305 to the mark, down from 1.8300, the NBP said.
The zloty was fixed at 2.35 percent from the floating parity rate, which changes in line with intraday moves of major currencies on world markets, against Monday's 2.53 percent fix.
The central bank fixed the zloty at an average of 2.48 percent from the central bank's weighted dollar and mark parity rates, weaker than Monday's 2.51 percent fix.
